rationale: The refactor spans three canonical owners and migrates all consumers while affecting product semantics. Compact Delivery is ineligible because the evidence does not show a completed Brownfield analysis or stored quick_task context; Verified Change is also ineligible because it requires exactly one canonical owner and deterministic propagation for derived paths. The cross-owner scope therefore supports structured_delivery as a non-authorizing benchmark candidate.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement.
The scope spans 3 canonical owners, 3 source paths, and 4 derived paths.
Deterministic propagation is false, excluding verified_change where derived paths exist.
No completed Brownfield analysis is evidenced.
No stored quick_task context is evidenced, so compact_delivery requirements are unmet.
The classification is measurement-only and does not constitute an operative Mode/Slice Decision or approval.
